nodes.label: Rebrand to dev.boudy04.taskvault / TaskVault
nodes.rationale: Full rebrand decision locked in spec: package/namespace/applicationId dev.boudy04.taskvault everywhere, no com.example.* remnants, new icon/colors.

nodes.label: Offline-First Mutation Queue Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every mutation writes locally then enqueues a PendingOpEntity, so the UI never blocks on network and edits survive offline; a HiltWorker drains the queue through Retrofit then pulls and reconciles the server list.

nodes.label: Room as Single Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Room stays the single source of truth so UI reads are local-first and sync only mutates local state.

nodes.label: SyncEngine (drain + pull)
nodes.rationale: 401 stops draining as FAILURE to avoid an infinite retry storm and surface a check-settings state; IOException/5xx return RETRY keeping the op PENDING; 404 drops op and local row.

nodes.label: DataStore Settings Store (ServerConfig: baseUrl + token)
nodes.rationale: Defaults are demo values (Railway URL + dev-token); real tokens must never be committed.

nodes.label: LocalTask Room Entity (schema v2 with status/priority/serverId/timestamps)
task-api Upstream Contract (endpoints and JSON schema)
Last-Write-Wins Conflict Policy
nodes.rationale: Safe because single user + static token; a deliberate simplification since per-user accounts would require real conflict resolution.

nodes.label: Unsynced Dot Badge on Rows with Pending Ops
Pull Sync Reconciliation (upsert by serverId, delete vanished rows unless protected)
nodes.rationale: Runs when the queue drains empty and on app open; rows whose serverId vanished remotely are deleted unless a pending op references them, protecting offline creates/edits.

nodes.label: UUID localId Primary Key Decision
nodes.rationale: PK stays the sample's localId String (UUID) so offline-created tasks exist before the server knows them; serverId links later.

nodes.label: Non-Goals (no multi-user auth, no periodic sync, no pagination)
nodes.rationale: Static bearer token is by design of the API; sync happens only on mutation/open/connectivity for portfolio scale.
